title: Hilton to Debut in Canberra with Signing of Hilton Canberra Manuka
summary: The Hilton Canberra Manuka hotel will bring Hilton’s flagship Hilton Hotels & Resorts brand to Australia’s national capital.
body_markdown:
Listen to this article


0:00


The 184‑room hotel will bring Hilton’s flagship Hilton Hotels & Resorts brand to the heart of Manuka in Australia’s national capital


- **Hilton Canberra Manuka is expected to open in early 2027 at 15–17 Franklin Street, Manuka.**
- **The franchise signing with ICC Development Group will mark Hilton’s entry into Canberra.**
- **Facilities will include an all-day dining restaurant and bar, wedding and event spaces, an executive lounge, fitness and wellness facilities, a sauna and a pool.**


**CANBERRA, Australia –**[Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/corporate/) (Nasdaq: HLT) today announced the signing of Hilton Canberra Manuka, a 184-room hotel expected to open in early 2027. Located at 15–17 Franklin Street, Manuka in Canberra’s established Manuka precinct, the hotel will introduce the flagship[Hilton Hotels & Resorts](https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/hilton-hotels/) brand to Australia’s national capital. Operating under a franchise agreement with ICC Development Group.


Directly opposite Manuka Oval, the property will cater to government, corporate, diplomatic, sporting and leisure travellers and will offer convenient access to Parliament House, the Parliamentary Triangle, Canberra’s embassy district, the Barton business precinct and major cultural attractions. Canberra Railway Station is approximately 1.5 kilometres away, while Canberra Airport is approximately seven kilometres from the property.


Hilton Canberra Manuka - Lobby


“The signing of Hilton Canberra Manuka represents an important milestone in Hilton’s growth across Australasia and brings our flagship brand to Australia’s national capital,” said Tushar Raniga, director of development, Hilton Australasia. “With its location in one of Canberra’s most established precincts and proximity to key government, diplomatic, corporate and leisure demand drivers, the hotel is well positioned to welcome guests travelling for a wide range of occasions. We are pleased to begin a new relationship with ICC Development Group and look forward to bringing Hilton’s signature hospitality to Canberra.”


“Bringing Hilton’s flagship brand to Manuka is a significant milestone for ICC Development Group,” said Harrold Dakin, CEO of ICC Development Group. “Hilton Canberra Manuka represents a significant private investment by Mrs. Liangis in Canberra’s tourism and hospitality sector, and we are proud to play a part in bringing this internationally recognised hotel brand to the heart of Manuka.”


“The hotel is expected to support approximately 100–120 ongoing full-time, part-time and casual positions, creating local employment and career opportunities across hospitality and hotel management. Hilton Canberra Manuka is also expected to drive strong, ongoing visitor spending and demand for local goods and services, supporting the precinct’s restaurants, cafés, retailers and suppliers.”


“This project reflects our broader ambition to build an international hospitality portfolio that brings together well-position properties, global hotel brands and experienced operating partners. Our partnership with Hilton is an important step towards that vision, combining the brand’s hospitality expertise with a distinctive sense of place and exceptional guest service.”


Hilton Canberra Manuka - Lounge


Hilton Canberra Manuka will offer 184 guest rooms, including eight suites, with standard rooms ranging from 32 to 45 square metres. Facilities will include an executive lounge, an all-day dining restaurant and bar, fitness and wellness facilities, a sauna and a pool.


The hotel’s wedding and event facilities will include a ballroom and a multifunction space that can be divided into four rooms, accommodating occasions ranging from executive meetings to private celebrations.


Guests will be within easy reach of the National Gallery of Australia, the National Museum of Australia and Questacon, while Manuka Oval sits directly opposite the hotel. Ground-level retail, additional dining venues and a cinema will form part of the broader development, connecting the hotel with the surrounding precinct.


Hilton Canberra Manuka will participate in Hilton Honors, Hilton’s award-winning guest loyalty program. Members who book directly through preferred Hilton channels can access benefits including exclusive member discounts, complimentary standard Wi-Fi and flexible Points & Money payment options. Through the Hilton Honors app, guests can also access digital tools including check-in, room selection and Digital Key, where available.


Read more about Hilton Hotels & Resorts at[stories.hilton.com/hhr](https://stories.hilton.com/hhr) .


##### FAQ: Hilton to Debut in Canberra with Signing of Hilton Canberra Manuka


Hilton Canberra Manuka is a 184-room hotel at 15–17 Franklin Street in Canberra’s Manuka precinct. It is expected to open in early 2027.


The hotel will operate under Hilton Hotels & Resorts, Hilton’s flagship brand.


The hotel will offer 184 rooms, including eight suites, alongside an executive lounge, an all-day dining restaurant and bar, wedding and event spaces, fitness and wellness facilities, a sauna and a pool.


The signing will mark Hilton’s entry into Canberra, bringing its flagship brand to Australia’s national capital and supporting the city’s tourism and hospitality offering.


The hotel is expected to support approximately 100–120 ongoing full-time, part-time and casual positions, alongside opportunities for local suppliers and additional visitor spending across the precinct.
